nodes.name: consolidation.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the MemoryWeaver class, which orchestrates memory consolidation operations including GOP (Group of Pictures) frame consolidation, importance-based decay and strengthening, daily summary creation, session archiving, entity-to-frame linking, content distillation, and project-level consolidation against the SQLite memory substrate.

nodes.name: MemoryWeaver
nodes.summary: Core consolidation engine that manages the lifecycle of memory frames — consolidating GOP sequences into I-frames, decaying stale frames, strengthening frequently-accessed ones, linking related frames via knowledge entities, and distilling session/project content into summary frames.

nodes.name: consolidation-enhanced.test.ts
nodes.summary: Enhanced test suite for MemoryWeaver covering advanced consolidation scenarios such as edge cases, boundary conditions, and more complex multi-step memory lifecycle operations.

nodes.name: consolidation.test.ts
nodes.summary: Primary test suite for MemoryWeaver verifying core consolidation behaviors including GOP consolidation, frame decay/strengthening, daily summary creation, session archiving, and entity-to-frame linking.
